Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: broad_filtered_scan is contextual.

query_with_too_much_join: An overly large multi-table join can increase cardinality and join work; it is not a lock primitive. Metric roles: execution-pressure is compatible_only evidence, expected direction elevated. Semantic query-shape roles: multi_table_join is direct.

record_lock: Conflicting record updates or transactions create lock contention. It can coexist with an independent read or query-work mechanism.
